text:
michelle: Heads up -- Anika asked if she can bank 4 weeks of parental leave to use later in the year. Thoughts? :baby:
omar: Banking is usually fine up to 6 weeks with manager + People Ops approval. If it pushes benefits into next year we need payroll signoff.
sarah: Also check FMLA start/end dates; banking changes the LOA window which can affect coverage.
michelle: What paperwork do we need to amend?
jen: Submit LOA amendment in Workday (internal). Manager approves, People Ops countersigns. I'll attach the amendment checklist.
jen: Checklist: employee request, amended dates, manager approval screenshot, People Ops sign-off, payroll code change (if unpaid).
michelle: She wants a phased return: 2 half-days/week for 6 weeks. Is that okay?
omar: Yes, supported. Manager + People Ops coordinate schedule and coverage plan. For on-call teams, include handoff docs.
sarah: Important: accruals and benefits proration may be impacted; payroll needs exact schedule by the 15th before changes start.
michelle: On-site: lactation room booking and fridge access for milk storage. Who handles keys?
facilities: Facilities manages fridge access and drawer reservations. We'll open a ticket and reserve a small locked drawer. Please cc facilities@redwood.com on the LOA amendment.
jen: I'll add lactation/fridge instructions to the LOA packet and include pickup times for keys.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit amendment within 10 business days to avoid benefits interruption.
michelle: One more: Anika is on H-1B. Could banking or unpaid extension affect visa?
legal-team: Tagging legal: unpaid leave beyond authorized period can impact visa status. Any unpaid extension must be reviewed. Escalate early.
michelle: Got it. Also her performance review lands during leave window. Pause or proceed?
sarah: We usually defer the live review; manager provides a written summary and any interim goals. Promotion timelines handled case-by-case.
michelle: Thanks. I'll collect dates and submit the amendment, and loop in facilities + legal if unpaid time emerges.
facilities: Ticket created for fridge/drawer/lactation key. ETA 3 business days.
jen: I'll update the LOA template this afternoon and share wording for the manager to use in the review note.
michelle: Appreciate the quick responses :heart:
